decks.notes: Utilize Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard to the battlefield. Use Brainstorm and Ponder to find key combo pieces while controlling the game with Force of Will and Daze. Orcish Bowmasters and Troll of Khazad-dûm provide additional threat and disruption. Wasteland can disrupt opponent's mana base while Polluted Delta and Flooded Strand help fix mana. Brazen Borrower provides additional disruption and tempo plays. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly and efficiently reanimating powerful creatures to overwhelm opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By utilizing cards like Daze and Force of Will for defense, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes some control elements with cards like Brazen Borrower and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan through aggressive creature plays like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Grief, backed up by a suite of disruption spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also utilizes reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat out powerful creatures like Murktide Regent. The combination of tempo plays and graveyard manipulation make this Dimir Tempo deck a versatile and powerful option in the Legacy format.

The deck focuses on quickly putting big creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty into play using spells like Reanimate, Exhume, and Animate Dead, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Grief, Unmask, and Thoughtseize. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and limit their options by discarding key cards from their hand. With efficient mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, the deck can execute its game plan swiftly and efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures to ramp up mana with Gaea's Cradle and control the board with cards like Endurance and Collector Ouphe. The key strategy is to use Green Sun's Zenith to search for specific creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth or Allosaurus Shepherd to quickly close out the game or protect against certain strategies. The deck also includes cards like Once Upon a Time and Elvish Reclaimer for additional consistency and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through efficient creature-based control.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of storm count by casting spells like Dark Ritual, Lotus Petal, and Lion's Eye Diamond to create mana, then using Infernal Tutor to search for Tendrils of Agony to finish off the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Veil of Summer and Leyline of the Void to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble help with card selection and mana fixing, while Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key artifacts. The deck aims to win quickly and decisively through its storm combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently put powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This strategy allows the player to cheat out big creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier early in the game, overwhelming their opponent with strong threats. The deck also includes disruption cards like Grief and Daze to help protect the combo pieces and counter opponent's spells. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and deck manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the combo pieces needed.

The main concept of this Legacy Combo - Reanimator deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces. Additionally, the deck features a variety of creatures with powerful abilities like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to control the game and secure the win. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful plays.

This aggro deck focuses on tempo play and disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic and efficient threats. It utilizes a mix of card draw, removal, and versatile creatures to maintain pressure and control the board. With a combination of aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and disruption spells like Force of Will, Daze, and Pyrokinesis, the deck aims to outpace opponents and prevent them from establishing a strong defense. The deck also includes some land denial with Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The deck focuses on using Cephalid Illusionist along with Nomads en-Kor to enable a quick and powerful combo to win the game. By milling the library with Cephalid Illusionist and triggering Narcomoeba, players can then use Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle for a game-ending win condition. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo and control the game. The inclusion of Stoneforge Mystic and Teferi, Time Raveler provides additional utility and consistency to the overall strategy.

This deck focuses on using a variety of control elements, such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage, to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It utilizes a mix of powerful cards and versatile options to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, provides additional value and flexibility in longer games. The deck features a combination of efficient creatures, disruptive spells, and card draw to maintain control of the game and eventually overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt your opponent's plans by dropping powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Dragon Rabblemaster while also hindering their mana base with cards like Blood Moon and City of Traitors. By using fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, this deck aims to establish dominance early in the game and control the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator. The inclusion of cards like Dead / Gone and Unlicensed Hearse provide additional removal options to maintain board control and close out the game quickly.

This Nic Fit Control deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Greater Gargadon and Titania, Protector of Argoth alongside sacrifice effects such as Mayhem Devil to control the board and generate value. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Cabal Therapy and Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents' game plans. By ramping with Veteran Explorer and utilizing powerful finishers like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Indoraptor, the Perfect Hybrid, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a grindy control matchup.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly generate storm count while building mana and searching for key combo pieces. The deck aims to play spells like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to generate mana, then use Infernal Tutor to find key combo pieces like Ad Nauseam or Tendrils of Agony. The deck also includes hand disruption like Duress and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By carefully sequencing spells and managing resources, the deck can quickly assemble a lethal storm count and win the game in a single turn.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt your opponent's mana base by playing Blood Moon effects like Magus of the Moon and Blood Moon, along with Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to further disrupt their spells. By utilizing fast mana sources like City of Traitors and Chrome Mox, you can quickly deploy threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Broadside Bombardiers to apply pressure and close out the game. Den of the Bugbear provides a resilient threat while Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offers additional disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

A fast and aggressive deck that aims to quickly deploy powerful artifacts and creatures, using mana acceleration to overwhelm opponents. Featuring a mix of removal spells, efficient creatures, and powerful equipment, this deck focuses on imposing a rapid threat and putting pressure on the opponent from the beginning of the game. With a strong mana base and a variety of powerful cards, this deck aims to consistently deliver a fast and aggressive gameplay style that can disrupt opponents and win games quickly.
